inputs.original_text: The protest at Unity Fountain in Maitama on Thursday looks like a warning that the National Assembly’s “reform” bills are a power grab dressed up as routine change. When both the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations are raising the alarm, it’s hard to believe this is just noise. The people pushing these bills appear intent on reshaping the health sector while making workers and the public absorb the consequences.
